about_the_game:
Bark & Bytes is a fast-paced, hilarious card battler for 3-5 players where cunning, bluffing, and a bit of chaos decide your fate! Take on the role of feisty robots in a high-stakes card game—where the loser gets served as dog food.

🃏 How to Play

  • Every player battles to collect four cards of the same rank while passing and refusing cards in a race to victory.

  • One card in the deck is the dreaded Dog Card—if you’re holding it when the game ends, you lose!

  • Trick, bluff, and outwit your friends as you try to avoid the Dog Card, or set up your rivals for a mechanical chomp!

⚡ Unique Features

  • Quick Rounds, Huge Laughs: Games are fast and full of surprises, perfect for online matches.

  • Wild Card Passing: Give cards to anyone—even across the table! Players in the way can block or force more choices, creating unexpected twists.

  • Abilities Mode: Choose from quirky, one-time-use “Cat’s Blessings” abilities at the start of each game. Swap cards, reverse play, read minds, and more—each game is different!

  • Multiple Game Modes: Try three different modes for fresh experiences every round.

  • Chaotic Tabletop Vibes: Bluff, block, and misdirect your way to safety.

Get ready to bluff, bark, and byte your way to the top—or risk losing your head!

short_description: Bark & Bytes is a frantic party game where Robots bluff, swap, and outsmart each other to dodge the dreaded Dog Card. Race to collect four of a kind, but watch out—whoever’s stuck with the Dog Card gets their head chopped off! Play, deceive, outplay, and pray you don’t end up as dog food!
